<!-- Generated by `bun run docs:reference` from seek's definitions. Do not edit. -->

Best for enterprise extract jobs. Hits Parallel's /v1/extract endpoint — returns clean markdown excerpts (and optional full content) plus publish dates per URL.

Part of [`seek scrape`](seek-scrape.md).

## Usage

```text
seek scrape parallel [options] <urls...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls...` | Yes, one or more | One or more URLs to extract |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--objective <text>` | Focus excerpts on a natural-language extraction goal |  |
| `--full` | Include full markdown content, not just excerpts | `false` |
| `-c, --chars <n>` | Max characters per excerpt block |  |
| `--max-total <n>` | Max characters total across all URLs |  |
| `--max-age <seconds>` | Reuse cached content up to N seconds old (default: provider decides) |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek scrape parallel` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
